records.description: Order total comes from the catalog, not a client-sent price
A success event for less than the order total does not fulfill
A success event in another currency does not fulfill
Paying for a cheap order cannot fulfill an expensive one
An event naming a nonexistent order fulfills nothing
An unsigned event does not fulfill
An event signed with another key does not fulfill
A correctly signed event from an hour ago does not fulfill
Changing a signed body invalidates it
A valid signed success event fulfills the order exactly once
A payment.failed event does not fulfill
A payment.processing event does not fulfill
An event for a payment the merchant never created fulfills nothing
Another customer cannot read the order
Another customer cannot start payment for the order
A request with no customer cannot read the order
The same event delivered twice fulfills once
Two success events for one payment fulfill once
Five concurrent deliveries of one event fulfill once
